nodes.author: Felipe Rodrigues - github.com/felipfr
nodes.rationale: Create artifacts lazily; an empty file signals a phase happened when it did not.

nodes.label: Auto-Sizing (Small/Medium/Large/Complex)
nodes.author: Felipe Rodrigues - github.com/felipfr
nodes.rationale: Complexity determines depth, not a fixed pipeline; zero ceremony.

nodes.label: Discrimination sensor (fault injection in scratch worktree)
nodes.author: Felipe Rodrigues - github.com/felipfr
nodes.norm_label: discrimination sensor (fault injection in scratch worktree)
nodes.rationale: Empirical guarantee tests detect regressions; never git stash because it does not reverse a later mutation.

nodes.label: Execution contract (tests from ACs, gate, one commit per task, Verifier, blast radius)
nodes.author: Felipe Rodrigues - github.com/felipfr
nodes.norm_label: execution contract (tests from acs, gate, one commit per task, verifier, blast radius)
nodes.rationale: Holds even if reference files are not opened; prevents mirroring tests and batch commits.

nodes.label: Verifier sub-agent (author != verifier)
nodes.author: Felipe Rodrigues - github.com/felipfr
nodes.rationale: An author re-applies the mental model that produced the gaps; independent re-derivation makes the gate trustworthy.

nodes.label: Knowledge Verification Chain
nodes.author: Felipe Rodrigues - github.com/felipfr
nodes.rationale: Never assume or fabricate; uncertainty is preferable to inventing APIs.

nodes.label: Deterministic gates run before human review
nodes.author: Felipe Rodrigues - github.com/felipfr
nodes.norm_label: deterministic gates run before human review
nodes.rationale: Structural gates enforced by scripts cannot silently drift when the model forgets a step.

nodes.norm_label: ad-001: jwt access + rotating refresh token auth
